summary: @servicetitan/moneyout-api-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package published under the @servicetitan scope claims to be an auto-generated TypeScript API client for MoneyOut, but ships a preinstall dropper unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares "preinstall": "node setup.mjs"; setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs the sibling file math_init.js under that freshly-downloaded runtime. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line file using string-array/index-lookup obfuscation (constant table with a custom decoder and rotator) whose contents cannot be inspected statically. Executing an obfuscated blob via an alternate runtime at install time bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and runs attacker-chosen code on every installer with the developer's user privileges. An auto-generated API client has no legitimate need for a Bun download or an obfuscated init blob, indicating scope impersonation or maintainer compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
